records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Total sales for the first quarter of fiscal 2024 were $115.5 million, as compared to $125.4 million in the first quarter of fiscal 2023.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Stores that have been open for at least 13 months are included in comparable sales.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: We continued to maintain our strong financial position, successfully managing our liquidity and our inventory levels, which are down 9.0% to last year's first quarter.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: For the first quarter of fiscal 2024, our gross margin rate, inclusive of occupancy costs, was 48.2% as compared to a gross margin rate of 48.6% for the first quarter of fiscal 2023.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Historically, and consistent with the retail industry, we have experienced seasonal fluctuations as it relates to our operating income, net income, and free cash flow.
